verdict.rationale: SumUp documents an official `@sumup/sdk` JavaScript/TypeScript package that wraps the SumUp API, ships TypeScript declarations, and runs on Node.js 18+, Cloudflare Workers and Vercel, with a code sample for creating checkouts. It also offers official Reader SDKs for Android and iOS and an Agent Toolkit for LangChain, AI SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK and MCP. Missing for 10: evidence of official server-side SDKs beyond JavaScript, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, and a publicly reachable OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404).
